(14) An outdoor seating area is shown with large square tan umbrellas, black modern chairs, and clear plastic domes for individual tables. (15) The interior of 'Feeling 18 LAB' is revealed as a bright, minimalist space with grey modular seating and large glass walls looking out to trees.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel and lifestyle vlog reviewing two specific cafes in Nantou, Taiwan. It uses a contrasting narrative to highlight that while the first location offers superior scenery but average food, the second location provides a highly stylized 'ritualistic' experience with excellent pastries.
